Name: Enchanted Ceremony - A Wizard Wedding Mod
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[size=3][b][center][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod was created because it always felt a bit off that the Wizard’s wedding took place in the middle of Pelican Town, surrounded by villagers he barely knows. To better suit his mysterious and solitary nature, I’ve moved the ceremony to the peaceful Secret Woods and trimmed down the guest list to a few meaningful attendees and magical creatures.
[/font]
[font=Tahoma]It’s a more fitting, magical setting for marrying the Wizard - away from the crowds, and deep in the heart of nature.[/font][/center][/b][/size]

[font=Tahoma]The Wizard doesn’t exactly mingle with most of Pelican Town, so the guest list reflects that. Many of the optional attendees are characters from other mods and will only appear if those mods are installed. But don’t worry, even if you’re playing with just the base game, you won’t be alone. Junimos and a few forest creatures are more than happy to join the celebration of this magical union![/font]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Features:[/size][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Tahoma]Fully custom wedding taking place in Secret Woods[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Tailored guest list (including attendees from other mods)[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]2 options for the officiant (both with unique wedding dialogue)[/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma]
[/font][b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Officiants:
[/size][/font][/b][font=Tahoma]Mayor Lewis is not [/font][font=Tahoma]invited! Instead, let someone who actually knows the Wizard take the lead. [/font]
[font=Tahoma]The officiant is configurable, so you can choose one that fits you best:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Tahoma]Linus [i][default][/i][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Camilla [i][only with SVE][/i][/font]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Guest list:[/b][/size][/font]
[spoiler]
[font=Tahoma]Vanilla:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Tahoma]Linus[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Marlon[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Krobus[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Dwarf[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Welwick[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Abigail (Only after seeing specific event in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18000]Adventurer Abigail[/url]﻿)[/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma]
Stardew Valley Expanded:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma]Camilla[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Morgan (if unlocked)[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Lance (if unlocked)[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Apples (if unlocked)[/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma]
Sunberry Village:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma]Silas[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Miyoung[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma]Moon[/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma]
Solo NPCs:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url]﻿[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Mr. Aguar[/url]﻿[/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]Eugene[/url]﻿[/font]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31663][font=Tahoma]Eleanor[/font][/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33082]Fleurine[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli[/url]﻿
[*]Jasper (Both the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]legacy version[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿ are supported)﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38698]Bill[/url] *
[/list]
[i]Any NPCs that have * next to their name are added to the wedding by their respective mods, not this one.[/i]
[/spoiler]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Compatibility:
[/b][/size][/font]Should be compatible with all other wedding mods (be it custom or editing the default wedding) as long as they don't edit Wizard's wedding specifically.

[font=Tahoma][size=2]Mod uses temporary sprites for vanilla anti-social NPCs attending the wedding, but takes into account Marlon from SVE and Welwick from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6462]Prophet Wellwick[/url][size=2] adjusting accordingly. The only [/size]inconsistency can be when players use seasonal outfits mods for vanilla Marlon.

Wedding Arch is a custom asset recolored to match the woods. Toned-down version is applied automatically with Earthy Recolor (can be manually enabled in config for other toned-down recolors).

The wedding map is custom and based on the vanilla Secret Woods, so while it will work with everything, if you're using any Woods changing mods (like SVE) it might look a bit different than you're used to, but you know what they say if something doesn't look like you were expecting it to... it's cause it's magic! [size=1](Yes, this is my favorite excuse for all Razzy stuff)[/size]

The mod itself doesn't add the ability to marry the Wizard, you need other mods (such as SVE or one of the RR family listed below) for that.

[size=2]All versions of the Wizard from the Romanceable Rasmodius family [/size]([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]RR[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]RR for SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]RRU[/url])[size=2] are compatible.[/size]

[size=2]Female version of the Wizard ([/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url][size=2]) is also fully supported.

Tldr: It should work with anything.

[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Debug Mode:[/b][/size][/font]
After enabling Debug Mode in the config and sleeping once, you can use command `debug ebi WizardWedding` to replay the event.

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Note for Mod Authors:[/size][/font][/b]
[font=Tahoma][size=2]If you feel your NPCs is friends with the Wizard and would like to attend the wedding (or maybe even officiate) be sure to let me know!
Alternatively you can now add them on your own! Check Articles for details.[/size]
